title: Formalisme algébrique des correspondances et algèbres de Poincaré-Hodge (cf conjectures standard) : notes manuscrites (s.d.), tapuscrit annoté (s.d.), lettres (1966-1967).

deep.reconstruction:
Context: this is a proof, by induction on k, inside a formalism of Poincaré–Hodge algebras. H^*(X) = ⊕_{0≤i≤2n} H^i carries Poincaré duality (a transposition), a Lefschetz operator ξ with hard Lefschetz isomorphisms ξ^{n-k}: H^k ≅ H^{2n-k}, and the inverses u_k: H^{2n-k} → H^k. The page shows that a subalgebra 𝒜 ⊂ End(H^*) contains the Künneth projectors and the Lefschetz-primitive projectors. Here 𝒜 is stable under transposition and contains ξ and the u_k (think of the algebra generated by algebraic correspondences, assuming the Lefschetz-type standard conjecture B).

Step 1 (Künneth components). Assume p_i ∈ 𝒜 for i<k, where p_i: H^* → H^i is the projector. Transposition sends p_i to p_{2n-i}, so p_j ∈ 𝒜 for j>2n-k. Put T_k = id − Σ_{i<k} p_i − Σ_{j>2n-k} p_j ∈ 𝒜. This is the projector onto ⊕_{k≤i≤2n-k} H^i, and T_{k'} ∈ 𝒜 for k' ≤ k. Then ξ^{n-k}T_k restricted to H^k is the hard Lefschetz isomorphism onto H^{2n-k}. Composing with u_k gives u_k ξ^{n-k} T_k = p_k. This completes the induction, so all p_i ∈ 𝒜.

Step 2 (primitive decomposition). Write H^k = ⊕_{i+2j=k} ξ^j P^i, where P^i is the primitive part (ξ^{n-i+1}P^i = 0). The claim is that the projectors onto each summand ξ^j P^i lie in 𝒜. The proof is by ascending induction on i (equivalently descending on j); the case i<0 is empty. Consider ξ^{n-k+j}T_k:
- It kills H^α for α ≠ k (after composing with the degree-appropriate u).
- On a summand ξ^{j'}P^{i'} with j'<j it acts as ξ^{n-i'+(j-j')} on P^{i'}, which is 0. So it kills N = ⊕_{j'<j} ξ^{j'}P^{i'}.
- On the complement ⊕_{j'≥j} ξ^{j'}P^{i'} = ξ^j H^{k-2j}, its composite with ξ^j: H^{k-2j} ≅ ξ^j H^{k-2j} is ξ^{n-(k-2j)}.
Hence u_{k-2j} ξ^{n-k+j} T_k vanishes on N and on ξ^j H^{k-2j} is the inverse of ξ^j. Composing with ξ^j gives the projector of H^k onto ξ^j H^{k-2j} along N. Differences of consecutive such projectors give the projectors onto the individual ξ^j P^i. The text stops at 'Donc'.

Purpose: this is the purely algebraic core of 'B(X) ⇒ C(X)': Künneth and Lefschetz components lie in any algebra containing ξ, the Lefschetz inverses and transposes. It reappears in Grothendieck's 'Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles' (Bombay 1968/69) and in Kleiman's 1968 exposé.

Note: the neighbouring pages in the scan (Bourbaki 'Tribu n° 65', étale algebras and the different) belong to an unrelated document and give no context.
errors: 'ξ^{n-k}T_k est nul sur H^j, j≠k' is literally false. For k<j≤2n-k, ξ^{n-k} maps H^j to H^{j+2n-2k}, which need not vanish. The formula u_k ξ^{n-k} T_k = p_k is still correct if u_k is understood as defined on H^{2n-k} and extended by zero on the other degrees. Alternatively one can insert an extra degree projector (e.g. T_k ξ^{n-k} T_k), which only picks up degree k. The same imprecision recurs for ξ^{n-k+j}T_k 'induit zéro sur H^α pour α≠k'.
In step 2, the composite u_{k-2j}ξ^{n-k+j}T_k should implicitly also be restricted to H^k (compose with p_k, already shown to be in 𝒜). This is harmless.

ideas.what: Künneth projectors p_i lie in any transposition-stable algebra containing ξ and the inverse Lefschetz maps u_k, by induction using T_k = id − Σ_{i<k}p_i − Σ_{j>2n-k}p_j and p_k = u_k ξ^{n-k} T_k
ideas.modern_name: Standard conjecture B (Lefschetz type) implies C (Künneth type)
ideas.usually_credited_to: Grothendieck (Standard conjectures, 1968/69); Kleiman (Algebraic cycles and the Weil conjectures, 1968)
ideas.where_published: Grothendieck, 'Standard conjectures on algebraic cycles', Bombay Colloquium 1968 (publ. 1969)

ideas.what: Projectors onto the Lefschetz decomposition summands ξ^j P^i lie in the same algebra, by induction on the primitive degree
ideas.modern_name: Algebraicity of Lefschetz/primitive decomposition projectors (sl2 decomposition) given B(X)
ideas.where_published: Standard conjectures paper (1969), in the discussion of operators * and Λ; details in Kleiman's Dix exposés exposé

deep.surprise_reason: This is a routine linear-algebra induction that appears (in essentially the same form) in Grothendieck's and Kleiman's 1968–69 published accounts of the standard conjectures. The page is a draft of known material with a minor imprecision, and contains nothing new.
transcription_corrections: Line 1: 'et le donc [?] prouvé' is probably 'et le lemme prouvé' or similar (illegible abbreviation); the sense is 'assume proven for k'<k'.
'on prouve ξ^{n-k+j}T_k' should rather read 'on prend (considère) ξ^{n-k+j}T_k'.
'et induit [?] ξ^{j'}P^{i'} pour j'<j' should read 'et induit zéro sur ξ^{j'}P^{i'} pour j'<j'. The inserted '{+est nul sur les noyaux N+}' refers to N = ⊕_{j'<j} ξ^{j'}P^{i'}.
'les projections sur ξ^j P^i est aussi ∈ 𝒜' should read 'la projection sur ξ^j P^i est aussi ∈ 𝒜'.
The neighbouring-page transcriptions (Bourbaki Tribu n° 65) are from an unrelated document misfiled or scanned with this cote.
